tagline.en: Create stories. Adapt them. Ship them.
tagline.zh: 从一个灵感，到小说、短剧、游戏和视频。

intro.en: All MIT-licensed. Write web fiction with skills in Claude Code, Codex and other agents; turn a novel into short-drama scripts and storyboards or a playable game; cut footage into a narrated recap. No agent setup? Write in the browser with ZenStory Workbench.
intro.zh: 都是 MIT 开源。在 Claude Code、Codex 等 Agent 里装上 skill 写网文；有了小说，可以改成短剧剧本和分镜，或做成可玩的游戏；有视频素材，可以剪成解说成片。不想装 Agent，就直接用网页版 ZenStory 工作台。

category.primary: agent skills for story creation and adaptation
category.note: Story creation and adaptation is the shared use-case family. Skill packs, a host-specific plugin and the separate writing workbench are different product formats; web fiction and short drama are specializations, not model or host names.

en: Start from an idea, a manuscript or a chapter to fix: use Oh Story in your agent, or write in the browser with ZenStory Workbench.
From a novel, Drama Skills writes short-drama scripts and shots and Novel to Game builds a playable game; from footage, Video Recap Skills makes a narrated recap. Make sure you may use the source.
Already on DeepSeek Harness? The Oh Story DSH plugin puts all four packs in its workbenches. It is a community plugin for that app, not something you add to DeepSeek's web chat.
zh: 从一个点子、一部小说或一章要改的正文开始：在 Agent 里用 Oh Story，或者直接在网页版 ZenStory 工作台里写。
有小说，用 Drama Skills 改成短剧剧本和分镜，用 Novel to Game 做成可玩的游戏；有视频素材，用 Video Recap Skills 做解说。改编前确认你有使用权。
已经在用 DeepSeek Harness？装上 Oh Story DSH 插件，就能在它的工作台里用这四套 skill。它是社区插件，不是装进 DeepSeek 网页聊天的扩展。
